preconditions.description: The number of vertices in the tree is between 2 and 105 inclusive.
Each pi is the parent of vertex i and satisfies 1 <= pi < i.

postconditions.description: The output is the number of distinct possible colorings of the vertices of the tree modulo 1000000007.

invariants.description: The paint function pseudocode is followed with the given conditions and the random number generator rnd() returns 0 or 1 equiprobably.
